versions.content: Specification of Secure Onboard Communication AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 72 of 161 Document ID 654 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SecureOnboardCommunication - AUTOSAR confidential - Service Name Sec OC_ Tp Cancel Receive Syntax Std_ Return Type Sec OC_ Tp Cancel Receive ( Pdu Id Type Rx Pdu Id ) Service ID [hex] 0x4c Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) Rx Pdu Id Identification of the PDU to be cancelled. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK: Cancellation was executed successfully by the destination module. E_ NOT_ OK: Cancellation was rejected by the destination module. Description Requests cancellation of an ongoing reception of a PDU in a lower layer transport protocol module. Available via Sec OC.h
